top_signals.title: Anthropic, OpenAI Clouding Other IPO Prospects: Ruder
top_signals.summary:
Brian Ruder, co-CEO and co-managing partner at Permira, joins Dani Burger on "Bloomberg Deals." They discuss IPOs, software companies exploring agentic AI development, and challenges financial firms face in appealing to up-and-coming talent.

 (Source: Bloomberg)

top_signals.title: The Costs You Can’t See in Packaged Goods Supply Chains
top_signals.summary:
FreightWaves and G3 Logistics are hosting a free Oct. 15 webinar on the hidden costs eroding margin in packaged goods supply chains. Register now to learn how supply chain leaders are identifying, quantifying and governing the exceptions quietly draining capacity and profit.

top_signals.summary: Representative French Hill hopes lawmakers could pass a cryptocurrency market structure bill before the next session of Congress in 2027 as SEC and CFTC actions weren’t sufficient
